basic_details.job_title: CSL Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online

age_limit.details: Maximum age limit is 45 years as on 31-08-2026. Age relaxation is applicable for OBC (3 years), PwBD (As per Govt. of India Guidelines), and Ex-servicemen (As per Govt. of India Guidelines).

qualification.details: Project Assistant (Office): Bachelor's Degree in Arts (other than fine arts/performing arts) or in Commerce or in Science or in Computer Applications or Business Administration with minimum 60% of marks from a recognized university. Experience: Minimum of two years post qualification experience in a Shipyard or Engineering Company or Commercial Organization or Government /Semi Government company/ Establishment.

salary_details.details: Consolidated pay of ₹ 24,400/- per month. Higher pay may be offered for experience beyond the minimum requirement. Eligible for compensation for extra hours of work based on CSL policy/guidelines.

selection_process: Written Tests (Objective Type Test and Descriptive Type Test)
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSL Project Assistant (Office) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSL to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSL Project Assistant (Office) post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the CSL Project Assistant (Office) recruitment is 31st August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant (Office) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Arts, Commerce, Science, Computer Applications, or Business Administration with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Assistant (Office) post is 45 years as of 31st August 2026. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for CSL Project Assistant (Office) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹ 300/- (Non-refundable, plus bank charges extra) for all categories. This fee is payable online.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant (Office) role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Written Tests, which include both Objective Type Test and Descriptive Type Test.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of two years of post-qualification experience is required in a Shipyard, Engineering Company, Commercial Organization, or Government/Semi-Government establishment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant (Office) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of ₹ 24,400/- per month. Higher pay may be considered for candidates with experience beyond the minimum requirement.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the CSL Project Assistant (Office) recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official Cochin Shipyard website between 07th August 2026 and 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the AN Ship Repair Unit (CANSRU) in Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

faq.question: Q10. Can I edit my application after submission?
faq.answer: No, once an application is submitted, it shall be considered final. Changes to the data provided after final submission will not be considered.
